story: The Brown Throated Fulvetta (Fulvetta ludlowi) is an extraordinary bird that belongs to the Paradoxornithidae family. It is most commonly observed in High-elevation montane forests; dense lower vegetation; bamboo stands; and rhododendron thickets, where its behaviors contribute to the ecological dynamics of the area. Listed as Least Concern (LC) by the IUCN, this species' future depends on continued conservation action. The story of the Brown Throated Fulvetta is one of adaptation and resilience, offering valuable lessons for conservationists. This poster aims to bring the Brown Throated Fulvetta into focus, highlighting its beauty and the importance of its habitat.
